notes: Direct HTTP fetch, no blocking. Site exposes a persistent 'Sale' link inside several category mega-menus (Lighting, Rugs & Textiles, Dining) plus a global /sale landing page and two further per-category /sale pages reachable by URL pattern but not linked in the visible nav (Furniture Sale, Bathroom Sale). No /outlet, /clearance, /final-sale, /last-chance or /end-of-line URL exists (all 404), and no /home-accessories/sale, /art/sale, /outdoor/sale exist either (404) - so Sale is not offered for those categories. SALE VS CLEARANCE REASONING: checked page <title>, <h1>, meta description and body copy on the top-level /sale page and every per-category /sale page - none contain the words clearance, outlet, final, last chance, or end of line, nor any 'sale ends'/date/seasonal-campaign name (e.g. no 'Black Friday' or 'Summer Sale' branding). The only page copy is a generic membership-discount upsell ('Become a Soho Friend today to receive a further 20% off'). Because the site's own taxonomy calls this 'Sale' (not a clearance/outlet term) but there is also no clear seasonal-campaign or 'limited time' signal proving it is a temporary promotion, and it is served as a standing item in the mega-menu (not a temporary banner), this is genuinely ambiguous per brief Sec 3 - recorded per the 'if uncertain, still record and flag' instruction rather than silently excluded or silently included. Parent /sale (37 items) is close to but not an exact sum of the 5 discovered per-category Sale children (3+2+13+19+1=38), consistent with normal single-item overlap/timing rather than a data error.
